plugins.prepareCmd: node scripts/set-version.mjs "${nextRelease.version}" && npm install --package-lock-only --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund && npm run package:extension && npm run build -w @datalabrotterdam/nova-ai-browser-host
plugins.publishCmd: npm publish -w @datalabrotterdam/nova-ai-browser-host && if [ "$PUBLISH_CHROME_EXTENSION" = true ]; then npm run publish:chrome; else echo "Chrome Web Store upload skipped (PUBLISH_CHROME_EXTENSION is not true)"; fi
